snippet.title: Only Axolotls | Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
- Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5205450/Only_Axolotls/

Only Axolotls is a cozy aquarium game where you collect, breed and customize axolotls. Explore new levels, discover unique abilities and build your ultimate collection.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🩷 What can you expect from Only Axolotls? 🩷

- CARE FOR, COLLECT, AND DISCOVER AXOLOTLS! Start your journey in a cozy 2D aquarium, discover adorable axolotls and their unique traits and abilities, and slowly build your collection.

- BREED NEW AXOLOTLS! Combine your axolotls to create new generations and expand your collection. Every new offspring is a chance to discover different rarities and grow your aquarium.

- GROW PHYTOPLANKTON FOR YOUR AXOLOTLS! Buy phytoplankton seeds from the shop and plant them to produce food for your axolotls. Manage your crops and resources to keep your aquarium running and your little companions happy.

- CUDDLES FOR EVERY AXOLOTL! Unlock new levels, meet lost axolotls, and use your charm to give them plenty of cuddles! Find the axolotls that fit your team best, develop their abilities, and take on new turn-based cuddle challenges.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
